authority: ChatGPT closes visual defects; Claude may only mark FIXED_PENDING_QA.

acceptance.structure: 100% approved sections/components present and in approved order
acceptance.intentionalVisualDifference: 0 allowed without new Lucifer-approved visual revision
acceptance.geometry: major anchors, containers and edges within 2 CSS px where browser rendering permits
acceptance.typography: font family/weight/size/line-height and wrapping must visually match reference viewport
acceptance.assets: canonical/derived asset identity and crop must match manifest/master
acceptance.responsive: no horizontal page scroll; mobile composition matches master
acceptance.states: menu/modal/form success/form error/FAQ/loading/404/focus states must match page 13 evidence
acceptance.automatedDiff: target <=0.5% materially different pixels after masking unavoidable font anti-aliasing; automated diff is evidence, manual ChatGPT review decides acceptance

playwrightRequired.networkRule: wait for fonts and critical images before screenshot; disable non-deterministic animation for visual capture
